rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No banned words (honest, delve, landscape, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage, synergize, paradigm shift). No em-dashes in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban. Word = exercise.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No ritual/ceremony nouns. No practice(n) as standalone noun-phrase in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dated markers, no transition verbs (relocated, became, used to). All content present-tense state.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match. AE101 voice quintet.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Boris (platform-flat): 'eval', 'automated check', 'tests, lint'. Godin (peer-warmth): 'same family', 'you can place'. Rory (reframe): 'statistical machine' behavior. Risto (forward-optimistic): closing 'The loop feeds itself. That is the flywheel'.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'no penalty, fine way to, it\'s OK if'. Direct factual statements throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture, not an article with user-supplied frame.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Darragh Curran named once (line 19) at Intercom slide. No redundant mentions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 31: 'The specific Claude you used today will be replaced, probably within months.' Unhedged, punchy.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + strategy docs, NOT body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise-specific rule; this is a lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Verbs: 'reads', 'places', 'runs', 'fire'. All peer-flat. No combative verbs (bark, order, command, whip, force, drag, push, boss, shout, snap, lecture, scold).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All headers match content: 'Eval' (names it), 'One primitive, placed' (placement), 'scales unchanged' (proof), 'runs on cadence' (scheduling), 'Why loop survives' (method survives model).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negations, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, citation duplication. Sentences carry semantic load.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 9: 'Three names, one thing.' Passes carve-out (§20b): memory handle + pedagogical move. Numeral does recall work the list cannot.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 21: 'shape doesn\'t change' scoped to shape-structure. Line 31: 'None of that changes the move' scoped to model replacement. Both superlatives hold within stated domain.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation. Body claims match backing block claims where overlapping. Cross-file binding not applicable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Meta-rule about sweep hygiene for judges. Not a prose rule.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 15: 'Naming it is what lets you reuse it' (capability, forward). No corrective framing ('you already think', 'you\'re missing').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'eval' earned line 8 (definition). 'judge/verifier/gate' earned line 9 (function-based). All terms earned or consolidation-scoped per maintainer carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
